name: Retrospektiva
source:
Semyon really wanted to return to the camp. He gets that chance. And along with that chance comes a massive headache in the form of mysterious new characters and an entire history that stands behind the enigmatic Sovyonok camp.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1376789497]Steam[/url]]
